summary: Run 2026-09-25 (entry 156). Iteration 4's whole Track 2 chain ran on Bloom syndrome (gene BLM): the phenotype twin over MGI mice, the PrimeKG walk, the PRISM sweep, LINCS signature reversal, convergence against a permutation null, and checks K1-K3. Every stage wrote its table with a manifest, in 53 minutes for $0, but only after one new driver (tools/transfer_it4.py, no existing line edited) and 136 recorded corrections of MVA text the tools write into any case's outputs.
why: A tool set that only works on the case it was built for does not scale. Bloom syndrome swaps the gene, the pathway and the clinical terms while asking the same kind of question, so each stage has something to find and a known answer to check against.
verdict: H096 refuted as registered (clause a): four stages keep their case in Python constants and seven write MVA text, so the chain does not transfer by configuration alone. Clause (b), retrospective: the best Blm genotype ranks at 1.15 % / 1.08 % of 76,699 (Recql4 ranks higher). Clause (c) met: the two cases' generator unions share 10 of 105 drugs (Jaccard 0.095). Nothing converges for Bloom and no drug survives.

inherits.what: Every tool of steps 9 and 10, unchanged: the phenotype twin (entry 150), the PRISM sweep (entry 154), LINCS reversal (entry 153), the convergence engine and checks (entry 155), and step 7's PrimeKG walk (entry 142).

figures.name: step11-t1-stages.svg
figures.reads: One row per stage, one column per case. MVA's column is the run built for it; Bloom's column is coloured by what running it took (green configuration alone, yellow configuration but MVA text corrected, red new code) and labelled with rows written and wall time. Four red, three yellow, no green.
figures.means: The chain's machinery transfers; its surface does not. Four tools need a --case flag and seven hard-coded source strings belong in the plans.
figures.source: tools/render_step11_t1.py over ressources/track2/transfer-it4/BLM/ (transfer_stages.tsv and the stage outputs), MVA's step-9/10 tables and build/it4/track2-t1/*.log; entry 156

figures.name: step11-t1-overlap.svg
figures.reads: Approved drugs listed per generator for MVA and Bloom (walk 50/50, twin 2/0, PRISM 8/2, LINCS 3/1), and the two unions: 52 MVA only, 10 shared, 43 Bloom only.
figures.means: A different disease gives a different drug set (Jaccard 0.095, under H096's 0.20 bar); nine of the ten shared drugs are PrimeKG hub drugs both walks reach, and dasatinib is the one drug both cases name by different evidence.

figures.name: step11-t1-twin.svg
figures.reads: The best Blm genotype's percentile among 76,699 MGI genotypes against 1,000 IC-matched random 42-term queries, for the symmetric and Phenodigm rollups (1.15 % and 1.08 %, p 0.037 and 0.021), and the best genotype of each within-pathway gene (Recql4 0.82 %, Wrn 8.43 %, Rmi1 31.4 %, Top3a 71.8 %).
figures.means: The twin stage finds the right mouse gene for a second disease (a retrospective result: entry 150 already ran this control), but not uniquely: a neighbouring RecQ-helicase syndrome gene matches as well.
